title: PCS Move Tips- Check that your car is in good condition
description:
Check that your cars in good condition 

2 weeks before the move you need to check the condition of your car. Be sure that your car is in a good operating condition for traveling. 

Have a 12 point or similar type of service inspection performed at the local auto body shop or dealer. Have repairs completed before your travel date.
